title: Merge Chat Message Windows
prompt:
An existing `get_chat_messages(message_id)` API returns the requested message plus up to five nearby messages before and after it. Each returned list is ordered by ascending `Message.id`; different returned windows can overlap, and `ids` can contain duplicates.

Implement `merge_windows(ids)`. Call the API once for every value in `ids`, merge all returned sorted windows, eliminate repeated message IDs, and return the unique `Message` objects in ascending ID order. Do not collect every item into a set and sort afterward: use a k-way merge with a min-heap. `Message.id` is globally unique; duplicate appearances across windows represent the same logical message. Empty input and boundary windows are valid.

The edit-history discussion from the source interview is a follow-up, not part of the executable contract.

example.input: ids = [2, 4, 6] with overlapping windows over messages 0 through 10
example.reasoning: A heap exposes the lowest next ID from each pre-sorted window while duplicate IDs are skipped.
